NCCP pages 3–4: proteinuria at least 2 g/24 h requires withholding; restart requires full resolution or less than 1 g/24 h. Do not substitute another VEGF inhibitor’s threshold.

Palmar-plantar erythrodysaesthesia grade 2 resumes at the same dose after specified recovery; grade 3 resumes at a reduced dose. Dose levels are 5 mg, 4 mg and 3 mg daily; inability to tolerate 3 mg requires discontinuation.

administration.cycle_and_sequence: A 14-day cycle: panitumumab, irinotecan, folinic acid and fluorouracil start on Day 1, followed by a fluorouracil pump for about 46 hours. Arrange disconnection around Day 3. Continue according to benefit and tolerance.
